name: Itsuka Yumemita Fuukei de
source:
The day the promise was given a bridge united two people. They continue to live far away from each other, but beautiful and ephemeral memories live on. Unfulfilled promise makes them guess what's on the other side of the bridge and keeps drawing people to this starting point.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
